item.title: Alexa and BOB are Friends
item.description: If you own an Amazon smart speaker, like the Echo Plus or Echo Dot, you can listen to 92-7 Bob FM! First you need to enable our skill. Here are 2 easy ways to do that:1. Say, “Alexa, enable 92-7 Bob FM Chico”2. Visit the Skills section of your Alexa Smartphone App and search for 92-7 Bob FM After you have enabled the Skill, listen to our station just by saying “Alexa, open 92-7 Bob FM”
